title: net2 r18e05 on net1 v6: test links, once
description: The one test-link run of the first learned net2 on net1 v6 to pass its gate: r18e05, round 7e's recipe on v6 (round 18's three gate3 DAgger students at teacher gain 0.5, exp-net2-r18-gate3-v6-162, seeds 1 to 3, as one policy on their mean beliefs, the stock-flow switch at 0.5, q unsharpened, copies handled by the fixed rule; release model-net2-v6-veto, named seed 0). It was chosen among seven candidates on validation campaign seed 21 (exp-net2-eval-v6-veto-166), then passed the gate alone on new validation episodes, campaign seed 11 (exp-net2-gate-r18e05-s11-167): five-family mean +0.018, cubic-first-60 +0.056 (+0.023 to +0.092), new-20 competition +0.027 (+0.008 to +0.044), copies -0.003 (-0.036 to +0.034). It runs next to the fixed rule on net1 v6 (u = 0.25, exported here as rule-v6 from exp-net1v6-149) and BBRv3 on the five test families (campaign seeds 13 and 31, as exp-final-test-100 and round 7e's test), the held-out competitors for 60 s, and 2 and 4 copies for 30 s. Reported: log utility against BBRv3 per family (experiments/rule_report.py), and per link the net2 minus the rule with 95% intervals (experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py, as at the gate). Run once; the result is reported whatever it is.
prepare: (cd "$IN/c" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v6/net1-v6-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule6" "$N" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v6=$OUT/rule6/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for f in "$IN"/c/ppo-r18e05-s*.onnx; do P+=(--policy "$(basename "$f" .onnx)=$f"); done; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" test 13 31 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/heldout.py "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60" --split test --family held-competitors --duration-ms 60000 --seed 31 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run expliccit campaign plan "$OUT/spec-held-competitors-60/campaign.json" "$OUT/c-held-competitors-60"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split test --duration-ms 30000 --seed 31 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
collect: uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT" --apart held-competitors-60 copies-30s && mv "$OUT/summary.md" "$OUT/against-bbr3.md" && uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_gate_report.py "$OUT" rule-v6
